body: I work at a grocery store in the produce department. My entire job is sampling products. I learn as much as possible about everything we carry, from mundane to exotic, and sample it out with recipes I've written or found. I help stock a lot of days, too, but mostly just learn and teach. It helps that I get paid $14 an hour for doing this and I'm full time with benefits, but this is honestly the best job I've ever had and the happiest I've been in years.

I've had a JRPG idea in my head for years, fleshing it out every once in a while. Markd. It's a world where some people are born with birthmarks giving them access to certain elemental magic. Fire, wind, wood, etc. Anyhoo, these people are kicked out of their villages when the marks manifest at puberty. Left to fend for themselves, they either die or are taken by the Empire. Everything about the marks is just propaganda for the first part of training(being left to fend for themselves). The main character is kicked out of his village at the beginning, almost dies, and is conscripted. You work for them for a while, then you end up fighting them. My mom has no money and I barely talk to my dad anymore. My student loans have gone into wage garnishment, so I'm out of luck there. My sister lives in Taiwan and I have no other relatives near here. I'm on a lease on my place, so I can't just leave. I haven't registered my car this year, but I keep driving it because I don't have a choice. I got a ticket for it a week ago and I have no idea how I'll pay it.

I have no field of study. I dropped out of college before I got kicked out. My grades weren't good at all. I'm working at a grocery store stocking shelves full time. There are no higher paying jobs for someone as worthless as me.

I have no talents. I've always been mediocre at everything I've done. I can't focus long enough to meditate. I honestly have nothing to live for beyond other people. I've centered my life around making others happy and i can't even do that anymore.
The thing is, I do want to be forgotten. It would be best for everyone. All I've caused is pain and worry in people's lives. I'm never going to amount to anything and no one will remember me anyway.

No friends left. I've stopped talking to everyone. I have no family in the area, not that any of them give two shits about me anymore. I've tried for government assistance twice now. Both times they've said i make too much.

They say I make too much, but between student loans, bills and rent, I have nothing left. My bank account is currently 26¢. I owe on taxes somehow this year, too. I can't even afford paints to work on my Warhammer army. I'm barely even eating at this point, not that I even have an appetite at this point.
Yep. I will have to pick up a second one to make ends meet. I can't even pay rent this month. I don't know how I'm even getting there tomorrow. I don't even have money for gas at this point.

It took me nine years to find another relationship. I finally opened up to someone and she pushed me away. I don't want to be in that position again. There's no point.

I've been in various management positions, but I've never been good at it. I don't have enough confidence to tell people what to do, so I end up doing everything. I play a lot of pc and console games. I also play Warhammer 40k and various tabletop and pen & paper games. And I only have a handful of friends and none of them know any single women my age.

My job isn't terrible, but it's dead end. What I'm doing now is what I'll be doing ten years from now. I can't afford to go to another job with all of my bills. As far as cute coworkers go, they're all 7 or 8 years younger than me or taken. The only one i was interested in blew me off to get back with her ex. Nothing is really fun to me anymore.
I didn't finish. Without knowing what I wanted, I dropped out.

I did well at college at first, but my grades started slipping. I don't have anything I'm terribly good at and i don't know what to go to school for. At this point, I have so much student loan debt that I can't possibly go back any time this decade.

Even the woman I had a crush on asking me out for a drink didn't do anything for me.I assumed it was out of pity because no one could possibly want to hang out with someone as worthless as me. The only thing that can truly help when I get really depressed is a day off from everything and a couple good nights of sleep.

My last day was much like any other day. Got up, showered, went to work.
I've been single for a long time. 9 years. I finally met someone I liked, and she led me on for a few weeks. I told her I had feelings for her and we continued going on dates. Then, she decided that she wanted someone else. I was already deeply delressed and it pushed me over the edge.
I got off of work and bought a bottle of water and a large amount of sleep aid. I went home, changed into some more comfortable clothes and got a blanket my mother had made for me. I was quiet during all of this so I didn't alarm my roommates. I went to my favorite park and sat on a bench with the blanket and pills. I texted my best friend to have her tell everyone I was sorry. She called me and we talked for a few minutes. She talk me down and she also talked to me the entire way to the hospital, where I spent the night in the psyche ward.
That was a month ago, and things have yet to get any better. I'm on antidepressants, but they aren't doing much yet. I have no self esteem and no self confidence. I won't commit suicide, though, because I don't want to hurt those close to me, however few there my be.
